title: Poky little puppy
creator_credit: Allan Frank Sandler, Zagreb Film, Sandler Institutional Films and Little Golden Books Films
brief_description: An animated cartoon about five puppies, one of whom calculates how to eat the desserts of the others. Designed to teach reading and number recognition. For primary grades. Based on the book of the same title by Janette Sebring Lowrey. Consultant Chuck Jones-Animator
